title: SB759 (2020 Regular Session): Increases the penalties for the offenses of unlawful transfer of weapons and fraudulent purchase of firearms

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official house.mo.gov or senate.mo.gov PDF of the version named in note (via LegiScan getBillText)

operative_text:
Section 571.060 (RSMo): Unlawful transfer of weapons under subdivision (1) of subsection 1 of this section is a class D felony; unlawful transfer of weapons under subdivisions (2) and (3) of subsection 1 of this section is a class E felony.
Section 571.063 (RSMo): Fraudulent purchase of a firearm is a class D felony.
